title: A Visitor for the Smile
author: Quentin Vane
blurb: Dominic Okafor, a hospice nurse who hears the dying count backwards, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. Then every mirror in the house starts reflecting the room one second late — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must finish the ritual the founders started before the last resident signs the papers.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
